d.ko: One cucumber. One space bar. Every three hours of in-game activity earns you one cucumber item. Jump, collect and craft. Drop designs and recipes change regularly. Once a design leaves the drop pool, it never drops again. Free to play, with optional cosmetic shop items.

d.zh: 一根黄瓜，一个空格键。每活动满三小时，就能获得一个黄瓜物品。跳跃、收集、合成并展示你的收藏。可掉落造型和配方会定期更新。造型一旦移出掉落池，就永远不会再次掉落。免费游玩，商店外观物品可选购。
